description: This is a Java test source file for the MessageHelper class, containing unit tests that verify the behavior of message property management, including content type, encoding, payload extraction, default property application, TTL handling, and custom property overrides within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: MessageHelperTest
classes.description: A JUnit5 test class that validates the various functionalities of MessageHelper related to message property manipulation and content handling within the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: testAddJmsVendorPropertiesAddsContentType
methods.description: Verifies that setting a non-empty content type on a message results in the appropriate JMS vendor property being added.

methods.name: testAddJmsVendorPropertiesAddsContentEncoding
methods.description: Verifies that setting a non-empty content encoding on a message results in the appropriate JMS vendor property being added.

methods.name: testAddJmsVendorPropertiesRejectsEmptyContentType
methods.description: Verifies that an empty content type prevents JMS vendor properties from being added.

methods.name: testAddJmsVendorPropertiesRejectsEmptyContentEncoding
methods.description: Verifies that an empty content encoding prevents JMS vendor properties from being added.

methods.name: testGetJsonPayloadHandlesMalformedJson
methods.description: Tests that a message with malformed JSON payload throws a DecodeException when attempting to extract JSON.

methods.name: testGetPayloadAsStringHandlesNonCharacterPayload
methods.description: Ensures getPayloadAsString returns a non-null string even with invalid UTF-8 payload bytes.

methods.name: testGetJsonPayloadHandlesEmptyDataSection
methods.description: Checks that an empty Data payload results in null JSON extraction.

methods.name: testAddDefaultsAddsDefaultContentType
methods.description: Verifies that default content type is set when no content type exists on the message, based on provided defaults.

methods.name: testAddDefaultsDoesNotAddDefaultContentType
methods.description: Verifies that an existing content type is preserved and not overridden.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesAddsFallbackContentType
methods.description: Ensures that when no specific content type or defaults are set, the message gets a fallback content type.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesDoesNotOverrideValidMessageTtl
methods.description: Checks that a message TTL is preserved if it is within limits.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesAddsCustomProperties
methods.description: Verifies that tenant and device-specific default properties are applied correctly, with device-level overrides taking precedence.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesLimitsTtlToMaxValue
methods.description: Ensures TTL is capped at the tenant-specified max TTL.

methods.name: testNewMessageUsesGivenTtlValue
methods.description: Checks that a new message adopts the device-specified TTL.

methods.name: testNewMessageLimitsTtlToMaxValue
methods.description: Ensures that TTL for a new message does not exceed the tenant max TTL.
